definitions.explanation: Money deposited in a bank account.

examples.japanese: {預金|よきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧。
⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{預金|よきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To put it in a fixed deposit.

examples.japanese: {預金|よきん}⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認：00158_kakunin⟧。
⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{預金|よきん}している。
examples.english: I deposit a little bit every month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{預金|よきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧{預金|よきん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{下|お}ろせない→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧。
examples.english: Fixed deposits have higher interest than regular savings, but you can't withdraw the money right away.

notes:
{預金|よきん} refers to money deposited in a bank account. The kanji break down as ⟦{預|よ}→預：noentry⟧ (entrust/deposit) + ⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧ (money). It functions as a noun and as a する verb ({預金|よきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to deposit money).

TYPES OF DEPOSITS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧{預金|よきん}: ordinary savings account (most common)
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{預金|よきん}: fixed-term deposit (higher interest, locked period)
- ⟦{当座|とうざ}→当座：29548_touza⟧{預金|よきん}: checking/current account

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {預金|よきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deposit money
- {預金|よきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧: to withdraw money
- {預金|よきん}⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: account balance
- {預金|よきん}⟦{通帳|つうちょう}→通帳：09924_tsuuchou⟧: bankbook, passbook

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧:
{預金|よきん} refers specifically to bank deposits, while ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧ means savings in general (including piggy banks, etc.). ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧ is more casual and broader in scope.
